title: Duolingo reports Q2 revenue up 18% YoY to $298.5M, paid subscribers up 17% to 12.7M, below est., forecasts Q3 revenue below est.; DUOL drops 11%+ after hours (Akash Sriram/Reuters)
summary: Akash Sriram / Reuters: Duolingo reports Q2 revenue up 18% YoY to $298.5M, paid subscribers up 17% to 12.7M, below est., forecasts Q3 revenue below est.; DUOL drops 11%+ after hours — Duolingo (DUOL.O) forecast third-quarter revenue below Wall Street expectations on Wednesday, tempering optimism from its robust second quarter …
